test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-4) Official paper (Held On: 10 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster and the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

HTWCGY : WTHCGY :: ALTMHY : TLAMHY :: LGETDR : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 
• HTWCGY : WTHCGY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2571923974ac19cde16a1e3278a4bd0e1b09d263abf82f9fa633b0ff805e9f5.png] 

and,

 
• ALTMHY : TLAMHY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e196c1f8596a22a352e41fcbbef64a28fa630c2e383fb1d58689e143d75d8d5a.png] 

Similarly,

 
• **LGETDR : ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cf24c4e3c2bead6bef2358f3303269606fb7f654e4d81b371c7d4ab86798cfc.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"EGLTDR".**
